data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' solely because its LLM API request failed with an HTTP 400 error while reviewing .SRCINFO. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an inconclusive verdict.
learnings: Transient API errors (like HTTP 400) during individual file reviews should be retried or handled gracefully, rather than forcing the entire package audit to an 'inconclusive' state when the failing file is low-risk metadata.

Models should be prompted to recognize that .SRCINFO is auto-generated metadata and poses no execution risk, ensuring that a failure to parse it doesn't obscure the safety of the actual build scripts.
